purpose: Prospectively evaluate Candidate Generator v2.2 on a second source-path- and exact-content-disjoint controlled holdout before any full-dataset scan.

exclusions: all dataset paths present in the prior 8248-image scaled pilot index
all dataset paths present in the Candidate Generator v2.1 controlled holdout
all members of every SHA-256 exact-duplicate group from the 130000-image exact audit

interpretation_limits: This is duplicate-candidate retrieval, not cancer-classification accuracy.
Controlled transformations establish known positives but do not establish clinical or patient-level generalization.
The dataset has no patient IDs or complete provenance, so path and exact-content disjointness cannot prove patient independence.
Passing this holdout does not authorize family construction, classifier splitting, model training, or a full 130000-image scan by itself.
